title: OpenField Studio: a two-minute walk
_comment: An example scenario for the hosted Replay (recorded takes, no backend). Re-take it with: python scripts/record_demo.py --url <the Replay site> --scenario scripts/ui/demo.scenario.json. When real renders exist, adjust the take names and the waits to match them. Narration cues (say) are timed in the finished video and written to cues.txt.

steps.text: Same motion, a new character. This is a re-shoot: the clip's movement, a different person.
Characters are invented or consented: consent comes first, and a face check runs on your own computer.
Direct a shot. The Move Pad draws the camera path, and the plan counts every render before anything is spent.
In Replay, Recreate plays back a recorded run, step by step. Nothing renders here.
Every take carries a receipt: identity result, open-weights audit, models and licences, and the exact workflow.
Takes keeps everything, with exports under the take they came from.
